method.extractor_source: scripts/claim-capture.mjs (the published reference implementation), imported, not re-implemented
method.what_this_is: A dated re-read of every captured claim, recording what happened to the source: whether its visible text is unchanged, changed, withdrawn, or unreachable.

what_this_does_not_establish: Whether any claim is true. A re-read says what was served today, not what is correct.

Whether a change was disclosed. The published spec defines disclosure at the artifact level and not for a source's own edit, so those claims are recorded as CHANGED_DISCLOSURE_NOT_DECIDABLE rather than guessed.
A ranking, a grade, or a verdict on any subject.
